item.title: Entropy Cross-entropy and mathematical meaning of information
item.description:
I this article I tried to present a classical and in-depth explanation of entropy and cross-entropy and their relationships with uncertainty or probability.

Information and Uncertainty Link to heading

Would you really be surprised if I told you that tomorrow sun will rise from east? In another scenario, how would you react if you came to know that a military chopper is going to land on your neighbourhood? There is no doubt that former event is certainly going to happen, and your reply might be, “Well !!, What’s new into that?” and in a latter situation you might come out of your home exclaiming “Wait.. What.. Chopper!! When, Why, Does anyone have any clue?”. Now think again, which event carries more information for you? Here, considering information as a meaning rather than as an amount of information, would really help to establish a connection between information and uncertainty.

item.title: Hatasha se ek vyakti baith gaya tha
item.description: I heard about Vinod Kumar Shukla when he died and twitter flooded my timeline with his poetry, snippets of poetries and quotes from his novels and stories. I thought to know more about him and searched some details, I was shocked to learned that he was from Rajnandgao. He was honored with top Indian literary award - Sahitya Akademy Award in the year 1999. The town 50 KM from my native. I got interested in his writings and read some pieces. I was completely blown away by his simple yet profound style of expressing complex thoughts.

item.title: About Me
item.description:
My name is Salis. An engineering graduate and a computer professional who spent almost two decades in technology industry as of Oct 1, 2026. The day I started this blog.

I was born and brought up in Indian state Chhattisgarh. My native place is Balod, a small sleepy town approximately 100 KM south west of Chhattisgarh’s capital Raipur.

I spent my two decades of professional life on tier one cities of India like, Pune, Chennai, Hyderabad, Bengaluru etc, working in tech companies but I am still so much homesick that even the thought of not being able to visit my beautify town Balod, can make me depressed. This is the place I was born, this is the place I would like to breath my last.
